changes_this_cycle: Added a machine-readable 16-volume Mundarica completeness audit baseline.
Linked the corpus manifest to the completeness audit and made verified_complete explicit for every volume.
Changed Volume I status to working_transcription_audit_baselined without asserting verification.
Added tests that prevent VERIFIED COMPLETE unless every required audit gate is true.
Added the Mundarica completeness gate to the Streamlit smoke workflow.

streamlit_sync.detail: The Mundarica Streamlit selector reads manifest.json dynamically, so the new Volume I status is reflected without hard-coded cultural content. The workflow now runs the completeness gate whenever data or Mundarica tests change.

blockers: Volume I repository bundle does not currently register an authoritative scan artifact, so visual scan comparison cannot be certified.
Volumes II-XVI have no corpus artifacts in the current repository build.
next_best_action: Add a deterministic page-accounting validator for Volume I that counts and checks page-block continuity without treating the working transcription as verified, then surface those audit metrics in Streamlit.
